suggestions: I'm grateful for a deploy that went out clean on a Thursday afternoon, no rollback needed, no heart palpitations.
I'm thankful for the mamak uncle remembering my order without me saying a word.
I'm grateful for finally finding the root cause of a bug that had me staring at logs till 1am the night before.
I'm thankful for the stillness right before Subuh, when the whole flat is quiet except for the kettle.
I'm grateful for a teammate who actually reads the PR description before leaving a comment.
I'm thankful for the rain hitting the window while I'm still under the blanket, no alarm for another twenty minutes.
I'm grateful for a manager who said 'take the day' instead of just nodding when I said I was burnt out.
I'm thankful for my grandmother's voice on the phone asking if I've been praying, like she already knows the answer.
I'm grateful for a CI pipeline that's green on the first try for once.
I'm thankful for the smell of nasi lemak wrapped in banana leaf cutting through a bad morning.
I'm grateful for rezeki showing up as a small freelance gig right when the bank balance was looking thin.
I'm thankful for a long voice note from an old friend that picks up like no time passed.
I'm grateful for a refactor that actually made the code shorter instead of just moving the mess around.
I'm thankful for the office aircon finally getting fixed after three weeks of sweating through stand-up.
I'm grateful for my mother leaving a plate of food covered on the table even when she knows I'll get home late.
